verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage has a versioning page stating that a new endpoint version is released whenever a backwards-incompatible change ships, and the reference shows versioned endpoints such as v2 audit and v3 transaction processing. However, nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, timelines or sunset notices. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy and timelines, sunset/deprecation headers or notices, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: A new version of an API endpoint is released whenever a new *backwards incompatible* change is released.
